notes.title: Now in 5 Languages!
notes.content:
Hi, guys and gals, hope you are doing great!

[h1]The New Languages[/h1]
We also translated the interface and steam page to 3 new languages (and variations), so now we're supporting:
[olist]
[*] English
[*] Brazillian Portuguese
[*] Japanese
[*] Chinese - Traditional
[*] Chinese - Simplified
[*] Spanish - Lat. America
[*] Spanish - Spain
[/olist]

We hope you guys enjoy these updates!

notes.title: Some Quick Updates!!
notes.content:
Hi! We just published a few updates:
- Fixed the rank rising notification
- Mouse click cooldown is smaller. We changed to 13 clicks per second now. Before it was 11cps, but some players were clicking faster than that!  :OOOO
- Bonus points pop up are smaller now, it was too big in some languages.


Hope you guys enjoy the ride! :)
